sources.title: Zhangjiajie Tianzi Mountain Nature Reserve Travel Guide
sources.content:
Tianzi Mountain is located in northwestern Zhangjiajie National Forest Park near Suoxi Valley. The name derives from Song Dynasty history when Xiang Dakun, a Tujia ethnic group leader, launched a revolution naming himself "Prince Xiang." The area features rare stone formations including Imperial Writing Brush Peaks, Fairy Offering Flowers, Dianjiang Terrace and the Old House Field.

Opening Hours: 7:00 am to 6:00 pm Monday to Sunday. A single ticket covers the entire National Forest Park for four consecutive days.

Main Attractions:
Helong Park: Features a bronze statue of Marshal He Long and overlooks West Sea Stone Forest, Imperial Writing Brush Peaks, and Fairy Offering Flowers. Includes dining options and rest areas.
Tianzi Pavilion: A six-story traditional structure offering a 360-degree panoramic view from its fifth floor with Tujia cultural exhibits.
West Sea Stone Forest: Described as an expanded bonsai with dramatically shaped peaks resembling swords and bamboo shoots.

Cable Car: Costs 72 Yuan per person, spans 2,084 meters with height difference of 692 meters at 5 meters per second, taking approximately 8 minutes one-way.

Travel Tips: Plan 3-4 hours for touring. Use cable cars for descent to protect knees. Arrive before peak hours. Bring extra clothing due to strong winds. Stay nearby overnight to catch sunrise.

sources.title: Tianzi Mountain (Zhangjiajie): Facts, Map, Cable Car & Formation
sources.content:
Tianzi Mountain offers the highest vantage point in the entire Wulingyuan Scenic Area, providing views of all four subsections—Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, Suoxiyu Valley, Yangjiajie, and Tianzi Mountain itself.

Tianzi Mountain is well-known for the four wonders - the Sea of Clouds, the Radiance of the Moonlight, Rays of Sunshine and the Snow in winter. Spring and autumn offer the clearest skies.

The most convenient way to reach the summit is by taking scenic eco-shuttle buses that depart every 5 minutes from various entrances, then purchasing a cable car ticket (CNY 72 per person). The cable car ride takes about 10 minutes.

To catch sunrise, you must either stay overnight on the mountain or hike up in predawn darkness, as the cable car doesn't operate before 7:30 AM.

The tour time is preferably 3-4 hours. There are over 80 natural viewing platforms, with must-visit ones including Yubi Feng (Imperial Brush Peak), Fairy Maiden Scattering Flowers, and Mid-Air Farmer's Cottage.

Hotels have been relocated from the mountaintop to towns at the foot of the mountain, so it's no longer possible to stay overnight on the mountain.

sources.title: Tianzi Mountain In Zhangjiajie: Travel Tips & FAQs 2026
sources.content: Tianzi Mountain travel tips and FAQs for 2026. Located in the northwestern part of Wulingyuan Scenic Area, Tianzi Mountain is one of the four major scenic areas within the park. The mountain features stunning sandstone pillars, sea of clouds, and panoramic viewpoints. Best visited in spring and autumn for clear views. Cable car available for both ascent and descent. Plan 3-4 hours for a thorough visit.

sources.title: Tianzi Mountain Nature Reserve, Zhangjiajie
sources.content: Tianzi Mountain Nature Reserve in Zhangjiajie features stunning sandstone formations and panoramic views. The area is known for its four wonders: sea of clouds, moonlight radiance, rays of sunshine, and winter snow. Key viewpoints include Imperial Brush Peak, Fairy Scattering Flowers, and the West Sea Stone Forest. Cable car available for CNY 72 per person.

sources.title: Tianzi Mountain Nature Reserve, Wulingyuan of Zhangjiajie
sources.content: Tianzi Mountain Nature Reserve is one of the four scenic areas in Wulingyuan. The mountain's highest peak reaches 1,262.5 meters above sea level. Notable attractions include Helong Park with its bronze statue, the West Sea Stone Forest, and numerous viewpoints offering spectacular views of sandstone pillars emerging from clouds. The area is named after Xiang Dakun who proclaimed himself Tianzi (Son of Heaven) during a peasant uprising.

sources.title: 天子山_百度百科
sources.content:
天子山位于湖南省张家界市武陵源区西北部，是武陵源四大风景名胜区之一。景区总面积67平方公里，最高峰天子峰海拔1262.5米，最低处狮兰峪海拔534米。

东临索溪峪，南接张家界国家森林公园，北依桑植县。属亚热带季风气候区，年平均气温12℃，年降雨量1800毫米，年无霜期240天。

名称源自元末明初。1353年土家族首领向大坤应邀上山，在学士李伯如辅佐下揭竿起义，僭称王号曰向王天子。1385年兵败身亡于神堂湾。

核心景点：
神堂湾：四面是刀切般的绝壁，终日雾雨霏霏，据传为向王天子归天之地。
空中田园：坐落在海拔1000余米，下面是万丈深渊的幽谷，有3公顷斜坡梯形良田。
御笔峰：由六柱石峰组成，靠右的石峰像倒插的御笔，靠左的石峰似搁笔的江山。
仙女散花、点将台、贺龙公园、仙人桥等景观各具特色。

门票价格258元（含大索道、环保车），开放时间全年08:00-16:00，建议游览4-5小时，最佳旅游时间4月至10月。

sources.title: 张家界武陵源——最美天子山 - 携程游记
sources.content: 张家界武陵源最美天子山游记。天子山原名青岩山，因土家族首领向大坤起义自称天子而更名。景区内御笔峰、仙女散花等景观令人叹为观止。建议乘坐索道上山，步行下山欣赏沿途风景。天子山是武陵源景区内观赏云海、日出的最佳地点。
